item.title: Bentonville Daily — August 9, 2026
item.description:
Upcoming public meetings and notable government and business developments in Bentonville on August 9, 2026.
Upcoming public meetings. City of Bentonville meetings and advisory boards: Finance Committee (Aug 11), Combined Committee of the Whole/City Council (Aug 11), Board of Adjustments (Aug 12), Utility Board (Aug 18), Planning Commission (Aug 18), Tree and Landscape Committee (Aug 20), Public Art Advisory Board (Aug 20), Finance Committee (Aug 25), Combined Committee of the Whole/City Council (Aug 25), and Board of Adjustments (Aug 26). Agendas are posted for some meetings; others have no agenda posted yet.
Northwest Arkansas growth brings benefits and challenges. Local business owners report rapid regional growth and its impacts on businesses and the community.
Northwest Arkansas business briefs. Art on Square expansion opens.
Taziki’s opens Rogers location. A new café opens at 1771 W. Pleasant Grove Road, Suite 104 in Rogers, with approximately 2,900 square feet and seating for 85 guests.
Simmons Foods promotes executives, creates chief commercial officer role. Simmons Foods promotes a president of Simmons Pet Food to chief commercial officer and names a successor.
Walton Family Foundation grant supports NWACC program. A $599,139 grant will expand the Learning, Improvement, Fun and Empowerment (LIFE) program at NorthWest Arkansas Community College.
Heat advisory issued for Benton County. A Heat Advisory is in effect until 8:00 PM CDT Sunday with heat index values up to 108 expected.
